table.name: TLGNC_OUTPUTDOC
table.description: Stores documents (pdf, xls, etc) which are generated by output services. Example: delivery note PDF.

column.name: OUTPUTDOC_NAME
column.description: Human readable name/description of the document. Never used as a reference and therefore changeable.

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_lang_bs. Code of the language

column.name: DATA
column.description: The binary data of the document

column.name: DATA_MIME_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_mime_type_bs. The MIME type of the document, 4=application/pdf, 5=application/postscript...

column.name: OUTPUTDOC_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_outputdoc_type_bs. Defines the document type of the output
